requirement: The system shall load a real ECG recording and its expert annotations.
test_method: Load MIT-BIH Record 100 using WFDB and confirm that ECG samples and annotations are present.
actual_result: 3600 ECG samples and 14 annotations loaded at 360.0 Hz.

requirement: The system shall automatically preprocess the ECG signal.
test_method: Apply the 0.5–40 Hz Butterworth band-pass filter and verify that the output contains the same number of finite samples.
actual_result: Filtered 3600 samples using a 0.5–40.0 Hz band-pass filter.

requirement: The system shall automatically detect R-peaks without using expert annotations as detector inputs.
test_method: Run the custom derivative, squaring, moving-window integration, thresholding, and R-peak refinement pipeline.
actual_result: 13 R-peaks automatically detected in the 10-second Record 100 test segment.

requirement: The system shall calculate RR intervals from consecutive detected R-peaks.
test_method: Calculate sample differences between consecutive R-peaks and divide by sampling frequency.
actual_result: 12 valid RR intervals calculated; mean RR = 806.02 ms.

requirement: The system shall calculate heart rate from detected RR intervals.
test_method: Calculate instantaneous heart rate using HR = 60 / RR.
actual_result: Average heart rate = 74.4 bpm; range = 60.2–91.9 bpm.

requirement: The system shall calculate basic time-domain HRV metrics.
test_method: Calculate Mean RR, SDNN, and RMSSD from detected RR intervals.
actual_result: Mean RR = 806.02 ms; SDNN = 76.19 ms; RMSSD = 125.32 ms.

requirement: The detector shall be tested on multiple independent MIT-BIH ECG records.
test_method: Run the same detector configuration on five 60-second ECG segments.
actual_result: 5 records tested; 284.52 s of ECG used for final beat-by-beat evaluation.

requirement: The final detector shall achieve at least 95% sensitivity, 95% precision, and 95% F1 score across the evaluable multi-record dataset.
test_method: Aggregate TP, FP, and FN from final multi-record validation and calculate sensitivity, precision, and F1 score.
actual_result: TP = 338, FP = 6, FN = 9; Sensitivity = 97.41%; Precision = 98.26%; F1 = 97.83%.

requirement: Non-evaluable ventricular-flutter intervals shall be explicitly documented rather than silently removed.
test_method: Verify that excluded intervals are stored in a dedicated CSV file with start, stop, and duration information.
